record.body:
## Rationale

Moving the surviving modules in this phase changes imports once. The directory is clean right after the delete, and data-layer only reshapes content.

## Counter-argument

A phase that both deletes and moves has a large diff that is hard to review. Moving in data-layer keeps this phase to deletions and matches the earlier backend-frontend-split decision.

payload.choice: Move the surviving modules to dashboard/backend in remove-textual
